rows.title_full:
AN ACT CREATING THE ANTI-DRUG ABUSE COUNCILS (ADACS) IN ALL
PROVINCES, CITIES, MUNICIPALITIES, AND BARANGAYS THROUGHOUT THE
COUNTRY.
rows.abstract:
Proposes to employ a rehabilitative approach in dealing with the prevalence of illegal drug use to allow Persons Who Use Drugs (PWUDs) to have a decent life and a bright future.

Tasks LGU to monitor anti-illegal drug programs and to serve as an information gathering organization for illegal drug use in their locality and make them responsible for the assessment, counseling, and referral of PWUDs who surrendered for treatment and rehabilitation to their facilities.

Proposes medical, reformatory, and community-based drug rehabilitation programs and provides for the different duties and responsibilities.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09841

ENTITILED THE “ANTI-GRAFT AND CORRUPT PRACTICES ACT”

No. 3019, as amended, or under Title 7, Book II of the Revised Penal code or for any offense involving fraud upon government or public funds or property . . . shall be suspended from office FOR A PERIOD NOT EXCEEDING NINETY (90) DAYS: PROVIDED, THAT IN CASE SUCH ELECTED PUBLIC OFFICER IS NO LONGER CONNECTED WITH THE OFFICE WHEREIN THE OFFENSE CHARGED WAS COMMITTED, THE PREVENTIVE SUSPENSION ORDER SHALL NO LONGER BE IMPLEMENTED.
